reason: Adds a Settings shutdown page with confirmation and feedback, using the documented shutdown endpoint to gracefully stop the DSH service.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 设置中添加带二次确认和结果反馈的关机页面，用于优雅停止 DSH 服务。
summaries.en: Adds a Settings shutdown page with confirmation and feedback for gracefully stopping the DSH service.

capabilities: Adds a shutdown page to the DSH Settings interface
Sends a POST request to /_dsh/shutdown after user confirmation
Terminates the DSH service process gracefully
